claim_a: Vietnam-reported exports to Australia: USD 27.9 million, 6,542 t (2023) (XBA-29)
claim_b: Australia-reported imports from Vietnam: USD 12.2 million, 2,062 t (2024) and USD 10.6 million (2025) (XBA-28)
position_taken: Use partner-reported figures for destination flows and Vietnam-reported figures for totals
notes: Different years; the gap is too large to be timing alone and may reflect classification or re-exports. US figures agree closely (USD 29.1 million Vietnam-reported for 2023; USD 28.1 million US-reported for 2024).

claim_a: ALDI SUD group page (as summarised): plant-based products are 56.4% of the product range (XBA-15)
claim_b: Questionmark: 56.4% plant-based food in total sales volume by the WWF method (XBA-12)
position_taken: Sales volume (WWF method), as Questionmark cites the method
notes: Our read of the Aldi page was through a summarising tool; the metric description may have been paraphrased.

topic: Two protein-split metrics in the Netherlands
claim_a: Lidl NL, Eiweet or Protein Tracker method: 43.1% plant (2024) (XBA-02)
claim_b: Lidl NL, WWF method, protein-rich foods excluding dairy: 25.84% plant (2024) (XBA-02)
position_taken: Report both with their method; never compare shares across methods
notes: The Protein Tracker counts protein in all foods, including bread and cereals; the WWF protein-rich group counts meat, fish, eggs, pulses, nuts and analogues.

topic: Albert Heijn and Ahold Delhaize targets
claim_a: Albert Heijn: 60% plant protein by 2030 (Protein Tracker, about 78% of volume) (XBA-13)
claim_b: Ahold Delhaize European brands: at least 50% plant-based food sales by 2030; 45% reached in 2025 (XBA-01)
position_taken: Both stand; they differ in scope (one brand against all European brands) and method
notes: Do not compare the 45% group figure with Dutch Protein Tracker shares.

topic: Where Europe-bound Vietnamese wrapped foods come from
claim_a: Package ch27.6 and TPP-08: EU and UK retailers' private label through Vietnamese co-packers is the best-evidenced route (package)
claim_b: Supplier lists: Lidl's 751 food suppliers and Lidl GB's 390 national suppliers are all in Europe or elsewhere outside Asia; Asian products arrive through EU importers; Vietnam-origin items found on UK shelves are sold under brands owned by others (XBA-06; XBA-07; XBA-26)
position_taken: The route exists but is intermediated: the first buyer is the importer or brand owner, not the retailer
notes: Changes TPP-08 first buyers and first test, not the destination.

topic: CJ's use of Vietnam to supply Western retail
claim_a: CJ (2022): the Kizuna plant exports dumplings and rolls to the EU and Australia and is ready to list in their retail channels (XBA-20)
claim_b: CJ (2024): a Hungarian plant will supply bibigo dumplings to Europe from H2 2026; bibigo vegetable dumplings at Coles are made in Australia (XBA-23; XBA-25)
position_taken: Vietnam's role in CJ's Western supply is partial and may shrink for Europe (inferred)
notes: Not a contradiction in fact; a change of plan over time.
